profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap node, tagged telecom=data_center and named "Bitviking," is located near Mantova in northern Italy. The name combines "Bit," a common shorthand in cryptocurrency branding, with "Viking," and follows a naming pattern seen elsewhere among Bitcoin mining and mining-hosting businesses rather than conventional enterprise colocation providers, though Italy's data-center market does include some real, differently named colocation and cloud sites in the same general region around Milan and the Po Valley. This entry is filed as a tentative, name-based classification pending that confirmation, rather than a fully verified profile, and should be revisited when fuller research capacity is available.
